author: GamingBolt
description:
Lightyear Frontier offers a relaxing experience that starts feeling fairly repetitive from just a couple of hours in. It is let down by its sense of pacing, with the most interesting tools like automation arriving too late, and puts too many constraints on your efforts to set up a factory. 

Despite this, however, there are definitely some great reasons to play the game, especially if you enjoy setting up farms while playing around with concepts like crop rotation. Along with this, just roaming around the beautiful world in the mech can also be quite enjoyable.
title: Lightyear Frontier 1.0 Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
It's funny, isn't it? 2026 as a whole, I mean. For many months, we've been talking about some of the best games ever made, how a stretch of several weeks offered some of the highest-quality releases in years. And how ironic it is that a remake of one of the greatest games ever made should top the critics' ratings, not once but twice? 

But as odd as it felt to see one of my personal favorite role-playing games, Trails in the Sky SC, on top (satisfying, sure, yet still odd), seeing The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time dominate the conversation once more felt just right.
title: Why The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Is Ridiculously Addictive

author: GamingBolt
description:
We’re finally in Grand Theft Auto VI’s launch month, and for many of you that means it’ll soon be time to leave GTA 5 – at least for now – to spend time in Leonida’s open world. To say San Andreas and Blaine County are anything less than iconic is an understatement, and while GTA 5 and GTA Online won’t suddenly become unavailable once GTA 6 releases, you might feel the urge to tick off any outstanding activities before saying goodbye. 

So, with that in mind, we’ve put a list of diversions together – some are pragmatic, others absurd, but all are worthy of your time. Here’s fifteen final things to do in GTA 5 before you play GTA 6.
title: 15 Final Things To Do In GTA 5 And GTA Online Before You Play GTA 6
